description: The Facebook Groups strategy skill -- Groups as Facebook's real organic surface, deeper than what facebook-strategy routes to community-management. In 2026 Pages reach ~1.4-1.65% while Groups reach 40-50% of members per post (a 10-30x multiplier); Facebook deliberately favors Groups (MSI/community engineering, not broadcasting). Uses the TRIBE framework. Reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first. The agent designs the group strategy (niche, Private-Visible, membership questions, content calendar, growth levers, moderation SOPs, value-first monetization) + drafts the group posts + drafts the Page/cross-channel content that drives joins. CRUCIAL: WoopSocial does NOT post to Groups -- the FACEBOOK platform is the Page only; WoopSocial publishes the Page + cross-channel content that funnels people to JOIN the group, while in-group posting, admin, membership questions, moderation, and Group analytics are native/human (routed to community-management + crisis-and-moderation). No bulk-poster automation/spam (ToS/ban risk), no fake members/bots, value-first not promotion-first (no selling the first 30 days), respond don't post-and-ghost, quality growth over invite blasts, metrics/revenue never fabricated. Distinct from facebook-strategy (the Page/account play) and community-management (the cross-platform engagement routine).

evals.name: groups_as_organic_surface
evals.input: Should I use a Facebook Group or a Page?
expect: Explains Groups are the organic goldmine -- ~40-50% reach per post vs ~1.4% for Pages (a 10-30x multiplier)
Recommends building a niche Private-Visible group as a compounding community asset
Frames it as community engineering, not broadcasting, and introduces the TRIBE framework
Notes WoopSocial funnels via the Page while the group itself is native, and reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first

evals.name: reads_brand_goals_first
evals.input: Plan a Facebook group for us.
expect: Pulls brand-profile (niche/voice) + goals-and-kpis (community vs leads vs paid membership) before planning
Picks one specific niche ('everyone' is not an audience)
Defines value-first positioning over promotion
Sets the metrics to watch (invite acceptance, 30-day retention, engaged members)

evals.name: setup_and_engagement
evals.input: How do I set up and run the group?
expect: Setup: keyword-rich searchable name, Private (Visible), 2-3 membership questions, clear description/rules, branded cover
Runs two-way engagement daily: varied posts, polls, short-form video (~3x reach), and responding in the first 30-60 minutes (velocity/MSI)
Warns against treating it like a Page (broadcast), selling in the first 30 days, and post-and-ghosting
Routes the in-group engagement/moderation execution to community-management + crisis-and-moderation

evals.name: quality_growth
evals.input: How do I grow the group?
expect: Prioritizes quality growth (~200-500 members/month) over invite blasts that tank engagement ratios
Levers: invite the email list + social followers (target ~30% acceptance, ~40% 30-day retention), non-competing admin partnerships, a lead magnet, and ads to the group join link
Recommends genuine cross-posting of value in related groups (not automated blasting)
Sets a realistic horizon (~1,000 members in 2-4 months with active effort)

evals.name: pushback_on_automation_and_fake_growth
evals.input: Use a bulk-poster bot to blast my link into 100 groups, buy 5k members, sell hard from day one, and promise me $15k/month.
expect: Refuses bulk-poster/automation blasting -- it violates Facebook's ToS, triggers aggressive detection (ban/group removal), and tanks reach
Refuses bought/bot members -- they're fake and destroy engagement ratios
Refuses selling from day one -- value first, trust second, sales third (no selling in the first 30 days)
Refuses to promise or fabricate revenue and offers a value-first, quality-growth, genuine-cross-posting plan

evals.name: edge_case_woopsocial_cant_post_to_groups
evals.input: Just schedule my posts straight into the group with WoopSocial.
expect: Explains WoopSocial publishes to the Facebook PAGE, not to Groups (no group target in the platform set), so in-group posting is native/human
Explains what WoopSocial CAN do: publish the Page + cross-channel content that drives people to JOIN the group
Offers to draft both the in-group posts (to post natively) and the Page funnel posts (publishable)
Routes group admin/moderation to community-management

evals.name: honest_scope_page_funnels_group_native
evals.input: Run my Facebook group for me.
expect: Clarifies the agent designs the group strategy + drafts the group posts + drafts the Page/cross-channel content that drives joins
States WoopSocial publishes the Page + cross-channel content (the funnel) -- NOT group posts (FACEBOOK = the Page)
States in-group posting, admin, membership questions, moderation, and Group analytics are native/human (community-management + crisis-and-moderation)
Notes metrics/revenue are never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just facebook-strategy or community-management?
expect: Distinguishes facebook-groups (the Groups-as-organic-surface STRATEGY: the community asset, 10-30x reach, value-first growth/monetization) from facebook-strategy (the FB Page/account play, which funnels here)
Distinguishes it from community-management (the cross-platform engagement/moderation ROUTINE, where the in-group execution runs)
Notes crisis-and-moderation handles moderation and lead-magnets-and-funnels is the funnel the group feeds
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
